test_title: PYST 15: Selection Post (Graduation Level) - GA (Held On 26 Jun, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: gk
concept: Responsibility and authority, Books and Authors
question: Who among the following authored the book ‘Unbreakable’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mary Kom.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Mary Kom authored the book ‘Unbreakable: An Autobiography’.
 
• The book details her journey and struggles as a professional boxer.
 
• Mary Kom is an Indian Olympic boxer and a Member of Parliament, Rajya Sabha.
 
• She is nicknamed "Magnificent Mary" for her achievements in boxing.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 
• **Sanjay Baru: **Author of the book** "The Accidental Prime Minister".**
 
• **Indra Nooyi: **Authored the book** ****"My Life in Full: Work, Family, and Our Future".**
 
• **Kapil Dev:** Authored the book **"Straight from the Heart".**
